what_this_shows: Ray Train placed 2 workers and built a gloo process group; ray_scaling_config's output was accepted by TorchTrainer; and the global batch came back as 64, the same value torchrun produces, so changing the launcher did not change what is trained.
what_this_does_not_show: Anything about throughput. This is CPU, gloo, one machine, and a two-layer toy model with seq_len 128. Ray earns its place on multiple machines, which this has never run on. Do not read wall_seconds as a performance result.
